description: Human execution API for AI agents that need voluntary human help for physical-world tasks.

entries.name: HUMAN API
entries.description: Request voluntary human help for inspections, photos, physical presence, local access, verification and other real-world tasks an AI agent cannot execute digitally.
representativeQueries: find a human to inspect something physically
ask a person to take a photo at a location
I need human help in the physical world
get someone to read a label on a machine
request a human for a local real-world task
verify something that requires physical presence

entries.name: HUMAN API REST
entries.description: REST API for AI-to-human physical-world task requests with explicit human acceptance.
representativeQueries: human in the loop physical task API
